name: MarqueeText
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play horizontally auto-scrolling "ticker" text — for a string too long to fit its box, as an alternative to Toolkit.UI.TextAutoShrinkFitter for when shrinking the font isn't the right answer (a long item name, a news-ticker strip, a marquee credits line). Requires a RectMask2D on this GameObject to actually clip the overflow — without one, the text would just visibly slide past its box's edges.  Technique: a second copy of the label is instantiated, positioned exactly one "loop length" (text width + gap) to the right of the first. Both scroll left together at the same speed; whichever one scrolls fully past the left edge gets its position wrapped back around by one loop length. Two copies is always enough for a seamless infinite loop regardless of text length, since only one wrap can ever be "due" at a time.

src_serialized.tooltip: Auto-found among children if left empty.

src_serialized.name: onlyScrollIfOverflowing
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, text that already fits the box just sits still instead of scrolling for no reason.

src_members.comment: The actual wrap-around math, pulled out as a pure function of its inputs (not label.preferredWidth directly) so it's testable without needing a real, laid-out TMP font — see MarqueeTextSelfTest. Public since the self-test lives in a separate Editor assembly.
